item.title: Version 0.7.0
item.description:
What's New

  • Custom frame rate: any target from 1 FPS up to your display's refresh rate, per display and as a default, with a slider and a number field
  • Saved wallpapers and schemes show a real cover — the frame that was on screen when you saved
  • A scene you come back to opens on its last live frame instead of the static poster, and the detail page can recapture it
  • Pro: HDR output for Wallpaper Engine scenes on EDR displays (Settings ▸ Performance)

Improvements

  • Pro: scenes render with less GPU work per frame — consecutive layers share one encoder, and redundant clears and copies are skipped
  • Pro: a scene's scripts, animated textures and background decodes are bounded and reclaimed when the scene goes away
  • Library pages use fixed-width columns, so a card keeps its place as the window widens
  • The Workshop detail header fits the inspector, and the preset bar is one row
  • Web wallpapers receive their properties once the page is ready, and the audio visualizer is bridged
  • Quitting stops a SteamCMD download that was still running
  • A full-screen app that stops at the notch is recognised as full screen

Bug Fixes

  • A bookmark saved while a Workshop scene was playing could be deleted along with that scene
  • Web: a page answering 404 no longer offers Retry, and a missing index page is reported as missing
  • Pro: perspective particles in 3D scenes had lost their depth scaling
  • Pro: rain and pulse effects are aligned with Wallpaper Engine
  • Gallery tiles no longer flash when they scroll back into view
  • A low frame rate ran particles at half speed
  • The frame-rate field on a 60 Hz display no longer overwrites a 120 FPS target saved for another display

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen.app" once; updates Loomscreen installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
